changeSet.author: Abdula Basnukaev
changeSet.comment: ADR-057: удалить OCR pipeline колонки из lib_pages (ocr_status, ocr_started_at, ocr_completed_at) и индекс idx_lib_pages_ocr_status

rollback.sql:
ALTER TABLE lib_pages ADD COLUMN ocr_status VARCHAR(20) NULL CHECK (ocr_status IN ('PENDING', 'PROCESSING', 'DONE', 'FAILED')), ADD COLUMN ocr_started_at TIMESTAMPTZ NULL, ADD COLUMN ocr_completed_at TIMESTAMPTZ NULL;
CREATE INDEX idx_lib_pages_ocr_status ON lib_pages(ocr_status) WHERE ocr_status IS NOT NULL;
